clauses.title: Finding disposition values
requires: Give every actionable finding **exactly one disposition**:

fixed
accepted-as-designed
deferred
duplicate
not-applicable
needs-owner-decision
Judge findings individually; a severity label is never by itself a decision to change the specification or implementation.

clauses.title: The issue finding record names every field
requires: For each finding record the source gate, severity, the `issue_spec` it was raised against, candidate identity, evidence, impact, exactly one disposition, rationale, revised passage when the disposition is `fixed`, validation evidence that the revision resolves it, and the reply/status URL or explicit snapshot-C assignment.

clauses.title: The pull-request finding record names every field
requires: // AC-DISPOSITION: a PR finding record carries its source identity, as its source kind requires, and every field the shared ledger names.
const EXTERNAL = words('sourceUrl bodyDigest createdAt updatedAt');
const FINDING_REQ = words('findingId origin gate headOid raisedAgainstFingerprint severity proposedDisposition evidence impact rationale correction transport workflowRecord');
const PR_REQ = words('sourceKind sourceId observedHeadOid fingerprint semanticFingerprint authorIdentity authorType');
